summary: Traws Pharma, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) to update an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Citizens JMP Securities, LLC. The filing increases the maximum aggregate gross sales price of common stock available for sale by up to $3,128,399, supplementing the approximately $7.7 million already sold. The stock trades on Nasdaq under TRAW; the May 20, 2026 closing price was $1.62. This is a routine shelf takedown and capital-raising update, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, as it is not a transactional filing.
